input.question: What caused the basement flooding — a ruptured or burst pipe in your home, water seeping in from outside (groundwater, rain runoff, failed sump pump), or is the cause unknown?

input.rationale: Basement flooding has caused structural damage to flooring and drywall, plus loss of stored contents — all covered property damage to the policyholder's residence and personal property.

Multi-area damage (flooring, drywall, contents) affecting entire basement with significant remediation and replacement costs expected to exceed $5,000–$10,000 minimum; requires on-site adjuster inspection to determine cause, assess scope, and authorize mitigation work quickly to prevent further damage.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) discovered approximately 2 inches of water across entire basement upon return from work trip, causing buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to 1 foot, and multiple ruined storage boxes. Cause under investigation; requires urgent on-site inspection to determine water source and authorize mitigation to prevent further structural and content damage.
